C1_zd_nullity_spectrum.description: Simple ZD pair nullity distribution convergence across levels
C1_zd_nullity_spectrum.rationale_for_levels: Spec §4 proposes n=6,7(,8). n=8 SVD(256x256) x 32385 pairs is dense-hours; conservative cutoff at n=7 keeps runtime under minutes. OEIS A167654 already closes ZD-count, leaving ONLY distribution shape as open signal.

metrics.nullity_distribution: p_n(k) = count_n(k) / C(2^n - 1, 2), where count_n(k) = number of simple-ZD pairs with nullity=k
metrics.tv_distance: TV(p_n, p_{n-1}) = 0.5 * sum_k |p_n(k) - p_{n-1}(k)|, embedded to common support by zero-padding missing k values

thresholds.progressive: TV(p_6, p_5) < 0.05 AND TV(p_7, p_6) < TV(p_6, p_5) AND mode_nullity / 2^n relative change < 0.10 across n=6,7
thresholds.kill: TV(p_7, p_6) >= TV(p_6, p_5) OR TV(p_7, p_6) > 0.05 OR mode_nullity / 2^n changes by > 0.20 across n=6,7

C1_zd_nullity_spectrum.rationale_for_thresholds: TV<0.05 is the explicit example given in spec §4 as convergence threshold. We commit to it strictly. Mode-shape stability is measured by normalized mode nullity (most frequent nullity divided by dimension) to avoid scale-dependence. 10% bound is conservative given O(1) nullity ranges.

C2_associator_distribution.description: Random unit-vector triple associator ratio r(x,y,z) = ||[x,y,z]|| / (||x|| ||y|| ||z||) distribution and defect measurement
C2_associator_distribution.rationale_for_sample_size: Spec §5 prescribes M=10^4. With M=1e4, standard error on mean r is O(1/sqrt(M)) ~ 1%, adequate to detect 5% saturation thresholds below.

metrics.mean_r: arithmetic mean of r over M samples per level
metrics.ks_statistic: Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic between level-n and level-(n+1) empirical CDFs of r
metrics.flexibility_defect: ||(xy)x - x(yx)|| must be < 1e-12 for all tested triples (Schafer 1954 exact-zero oracle)
metrics.power_assoc_defect: ||(xx)x - x(xx)|| must be < 1e-12 for all tested triples (Schafer 1954 exact-zero oracle)

verdict_rules.PROGRESSIVE: mean_r >= 0.01 AND |mean_r(n+1) - mean_r(n)| / mean_r(n) < 0.05 for all consecutive n in [4,5,6,7] AND KS(n, n+1) < 0.05 for all consecutive n
verdict_rules.KILL-A_growth: mean_r(n+1) > mean_r(n) * 1.20 for 2 or more consecutive levels
verdict_rules.KILL-B_collapse: mean_r(n+1) < mean_r(n) * 0.50 for 2 or more consecutive levels OR mean_r(n) < 1e-06 for any n >= 6
verdict_rules.KILL-C_reconfiguration: mean_r stable (all consecutive relative changes < 5%) BUT KS(n, n+1) > 0.05 for 2 or more consecutive levels

C2_associator_distribution.rationale_for_thresholds: Spec §5 defines qualitative branches but provides NO numerical thresholds. We fix them pre-hoc: (1) Saturation 5% is 5x the MC standard error, avoiding noise-driven false PROGRESSIVE. (2) Min r=0.01 ensures non-trivial associator signal; below this the algebra is effectively associative at machine precision. (3) Growth 20% is asymmetric to collapse 50% because growth threatens path-integral convergence more severely (spec §5: 'free parameter forced'). (4) KS 0.05 is standard 5% significance; reconfiguration requires stability in mean (ruling out mixed drift) AND distributional shift.

C3_truncation_stability.description: Finite-truncation prediction-family stability via Cauchy convergence test

P_n_components: mode_nullity_n: most frequent nullity value from C1 nullity spectrum
zd_density_n: simple-ZD pair count / total_pairs = count / C(2^n - 1, 2)
prediction_family.definition_rationale: Spec §6 allows (i) inherited/mixed/new ratio, (ii) mode nullity, (iii) mean r, (iv) threshold-sweep success curve. We select (ii) and (iii) as directly computable from C1/C2, plus (iii-derived) zd_density which is OEIS-closed but included as normalization check. Inherited/mixed/new classifier requires O(pairs x dim^3) projector computation not yet generalized to n=7; excluded to avoid post-hoc method design.

verdict_rules.CONVERGED: cauchy_decreasing AND |P_7 - P_6| < 0.10 (absolute) for ALL components AND |P_7 - P_6| / |P_6| < 0.20 (relative, guarded by |P_6| > 1e-12)
verdict_rules.DRIFTING: NOT cauchy_decreasing OR |P_7 - P_6| >= 0.10 for any component OR relative change >= 0.20
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_LEVELS: C1 or C2 outputs missing or any P_n component is NaN / undefined

C3_truncation_stability.rationale_for_thresholds: Spec §6 lacks numerical convergence criteria. Absolute tolerance 0.10 is deliberately loose because components have different scales (mean_r ~ O(1), mode_nullity ~ O(2^n), zd_density ~ O(1)). Relative 20% matches C2 saturation threshold for internal consistency. Cauchy-decreasing is the minimal structural requirement for limit existence; without it no prediction family can claim stabilization.
